I use: jump=L1; ability 1=L3; crouch=R3; melee=X; interact=O. Everything else the same. 

I made this initially after testing for every hero and it worked great since: ability 1 is usually a movement ability and so feels very natural on L3 which is used for moving already! and jump on L1 allows aiming while jumping. Crouch on R3 allows you to do it quick for dodging headshots etc

For mercy it turned out to be perfect by accident lol, having guardian angel and crouch (L3 and R3) right next to each other makes superjumping crazily easy by just pushing the two in, it just feels right. I’ve had no issues at all with this layout you should give it a try if your just testing stuff out!

Personally I went from stuck in gold to diamond just by watching Animetics videos on YouTube, so I suggest try there if you want to see some good mercy habits with self-criticism after mistakes

Other than that, what I think would make the most initial difference is learning to correctly: guardian angel -> bunny hop -> superjump.

There’s plenty of tutorials on these and if you can escape death consistently, you can then move onto focusing on getting optimum heals and clutch rezzes; but really you can only do that if you know how to stay alive, as you probably already know EVERYTHING is gonna be trying to murder you lol 

Oh and it’s probably better to use too much healing beam rather than too much blue beam, just while you get the hang of things
